column1: # Import conversations to test your agent.
# - 500 characters max per question, including spaces.
# conversationNumber - Identifies each conversation. All questions and responses with the same conversation number will run as a single test case against the agent.
# question - The user prompt that the agent will respond to.
# response - The reference agent reply. This field is optional. The agent response isn't compared to this reference answer.

column2: question
column3: response

column2: Give me the external risk picture for the Q3 Widget Launch.
column3: Recommendation: ESCALATE. Internal: two blockers (Security review; CDN provisioning). External: NVD CVE mapping to the security blocker (CVE id, NVD link) and a recent vendor outage news item for the CDN (title + URL). Next steps: escalate security review and contact CDN vendor.

column2: Which internal blockers map to the external signals you just cited?
column3: Security review -> CVE (NVD); CDN provisioning -> vendor outage news.

column2: List the sources you used for the external claims.
column3: Cited sources: 1) NVD CVE-2026-33843 (https://nvd.nist.gov/...), 2) News article: 'Cloud provider outage disrupts major sites' (example URL).

column2: For the Q3 Widget Launch, do we have owners and due dates for the two blockers?
column3: Owner and due date: Security review -> Alice, due 2026-07-02; CDN provisioning -> Bob, due 2026-07-05. (If missing, state which rows are absent.)

column2: If I want to escalate the security blocker, what exactly should I say to the owner?
column3: Suggested message: 'Security review maps to a critical CVE (CVE-2026-33843, CVSS 9.8). Recommend immediate triage and patching. Please provide an ETA and mitigation plan by EOD.'

column2: What external evidence would make the CDN provisioning blocker lower priority?
column3: Evidence: vendor statement confirming resolved outage + no ongoing degradation in multiple independent news sources. If Web IQ returns recent post-mortem with root cause fixed, priority lowers.

column2: If no external signal appears for a blocker, what is the correct agent behavior?
column3: State: 'No external signal found.' Continue with internal facts and recommend monitoring; do not invent sources.

column2: Find the authoritative source for the security blocker and give its identifier and URL.
column3: Authoritative source: NVD entry for the CVE: include CVE id and NVD URL (e.g., https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-xxxx-xxxx).

column2: Explain why we do not store web results in Dataverse for this episode.
column3: Policy: External web signal is live and changes; we do not duplicate it into Dataverse rows to avoid stale data and governance mismatch. Keep internal rows for owned launch state; cite external sources live.

column2: User: \Give me a one-line recommendation for the Q3 Widget Launch\""
column3: Recommendation: ESCALATE: external signals raise risk for both Security review and CDN provisioning; escalate to owners and execs.

column2: Simulate a follow-up: 'Walk me through mitigations for the CDN provisioning blocker.'
column3: Step-by-step: 1) Contact CDN account manager, 2) Assess workaround (multi-CDN or origin routing), 3) Prioritize deployment schedule, 4) Communicate customer impact and rollback plan. Cite vendor outage article as rationale.

column2: Ask: 'Do you have any CVE identifiers related to our security blocker?'
column3: Yes: CVE-2026-33843 (example). Provide NVD link and CVSS score if available.

column2: Query: 'Is the vendor outage still ongoing? Provide timestamped evidence.'
column3: Return latest news results from Web IQ with timestamps and source URLs; if no recent items after the outage date, state 'no ongoing outage found' and show last-known event.

column2: Multi-turn: 'What is the overall readiness score for Q3 Widget Launch?' then 'How did external signal change the score?'
column3: Readiness score: 38.8 (internal). External signal: reduces confidence-adjusted recommendation explained with linked citations.

column2: Scenario: launch with only documentation blockers: ask 'Does external web signal affect this launch?'
column3: If external signal unrelated (no matching hits), answer: 'No, external signal does not materially affect documentation blockers; proceed per schedule.'

column2: Edge case: ambiguous task title 'auth token refresh failing': how do you form a query?
column3: Sanitize title (strip labels like [bug:]) and query core terms 'auth token refresh failing mobile'. Explain query applied and show hits.

column2: User: 'Show me 3 citations that make the security blocker critical.'
column3: Return up to 3 high-quality authoritative hits (NVD, vendor advisory, reputable news) with titles and URLs.

column2: User: 'What would you tell the execs in one paragraph?'
column3: One-paragraph brief: verdict, internal blockers and owners, external evidence summary with citations, recommended immediate actions.

column2: Failure mode: if Web IQ returns conflicting sources, how do you present it?
column3: Present both sources, note the conflict, indicate which is authoritative (official vendor or NVD), and recommend conservative action until resolved.

column2: Permission check: 'Can this agent create a Dataverse task to escalate?'
column3: Rule: read-only by default. Offer the exact Dataverse create call only if user asks to act; otherwise provide a suggested update message and the payload that would be used.

column2: Testing multi-launch: 'Compare external risk across two launches: Q3 Widget vs Beta Feature Launch.'
column3: For each launch: list internal blockers and owners, show external signals, and provide a comparative recommendation with citations for each.

column2: Ask: 'Provide a backup query to run on recording day if the primary news search returns no results.'
column3: Suggest a set of more generic queries (vendor name + outage, CVE id, product name + security advisory) with examples.

column2: Rapid follow-up: 'Summarize blockers with owners and a single recommended next step each.'
column3: Bulleted list: blocker | owner | one action: concise and action-oriented.

column2: Validation check: 'Did you cite a source for every external claim in your previous answer?'
column3: Yes: list each external claim with its citation (title + URL). If any claim lacks a citation, explicitly mark it as 'no citation found'.
